analyst_view.overall: Early view: Massimiliano Allegri's Napoli (10th, winless in three) host Ruben Amorim's Milan (4th) on a Sunday night. Napoli have had an injury crisis, including muscle problems for Di Lorenzo and Olivera in early November, and play Club Brugge in the Champions League on Tuesday 8 December. Milan host Sunderland in the Europa League on Thursday 10 December, so they will have only three days to recover.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. Allegri has switched to a back three to cope with injuries, Napoli have won only two of their last eight games, and Milan arrive on short rest after a Thursday game, so I lean lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Napoli's wing-backs push on in Allegri's 3-4-2-1, but Milan's quick turnaround makes the game's shape hard to read this far out, so I stay with the site's number.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards, which is low for a big game between two clubs under pressure. Napoli had Luca Marianucci sent off at Juventus, and a tired Milan side may have to foul more to slow Napoli down at the Maradona.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.3 shots. Milan's legs after the Sunderland game and Allegri's cautious approach point to a slower game with fewer attempts.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. For the same reasons I expect fewer clear chances, though De Bruyne and Hojlund being fit for Napoli by then would change this.
